packages.name: cache
packages.doc:
Package cache is the remote tier of the cache domain: a core/data/cache
Store over Valkey or Redis through go-redis, implementing the four ports —
Store, EntryFetcher, Tagger and Loader — so internal/service/data/cache's
NewChain accepts it as its far tier behind a memory store (ADR 0049,
ADR 0211). It lives in the go-redis vendor module, third-party/db/redis,
named by its vendor rather than by one package (#984).

# Keys

Every key of one store shares the hash tag of Config.Prefix, so the store
lives on one slot of a cluster and every write is one atomic script: the
value under {prefix}:v:<key>, the entry's tags under {prefix}:t:<key>, and
each tag's members under {prefix}:g:<tag>. A store therefore does not shard
across a cluster; two stores with two prefixes do.

# What the server owns

An entry's deadline is the server's: Set writes it with PX, FetchEntry reads
the remaining TTL with PTTL, so promotion carries the time left, never the
time first asked for. Values are encoded with Config.Codec; a value that
does not decode is ValueUndecodable, never a silent miss.

# Loader across replicas

Load collapses concurrent misses on one key within the process, as the
port promises, and, when Config.FillLease is positive, across processes:
the first caller takes {prefix}:l:<key> with SET NX PX FillLease and fills,
the others poll every FillPoll on the injected clock until the value
appears or the lease is gone. The lease is not fenced — a filler that
outlives it may race a second one, and the later Set wins — the
non-guarantee the lock domain states for its own leases (ADR 0052).

packages.name: queue
packages.doc:
Package queue is a core/data/queue Broker over a Valkey or Redis stream and
one consumer group (ADR 0054's deferred connector, ADR 0211), in the
go-redis vendor module named by its vendor (#984).

# Mapping

Publish is XADD, the entry id the message's ID. Receive first reclaims what
lapsed — a lease past its deadline, dead-lettered when its deliveries are
spent —, leases again the hand-backs whose instant has come (XCLAIM), then
reads new entries with XREADGROUP; the pending-entries list holds every
message from its first lease to its XACK. Ack is XACK and XDEL, so one
stream is one queue. A message that runs out of attempts moves to the
dead-letter stream, its cause beside it, in the same script that removes
it. Receive and every settlement are one Lua script, atomic on the
server, and every key of one broker shares the stream's hash tag, so a
broker lives on one slot of a cluster. A failed command is
StreamUnreachable or CommandRefused, core/data/queue.QueueBackendFailed
in its trail.

# Whose clock is the lease

The lease deadlines are the broker's, read from StreamConfig.Clock and kept
in a sorted set beside the stream, to the microsecond — not the server's idle
time, which XAUTOCLAIM would read: a test drives every deadline with a
ManualClock, as for the SQL broker, and replicas agree as far as their
clocks do. The broker computes every instant and passes it to the script
as text. A receipt names the entry, the token of its lease and its
delivery, so a lapsed or replaced lease is LeaseExpired and one this
package never minted UnknownReceipt.

# Capabilities

Waker (a publication or hand-back by this process, and the next deadline
it knows of), LeaseExtender, Rejecter, Releaser, DelayedNacker and
DeadLetterReader. Out of scope: hash-slot placement across a cluster (one
stream is one slot), and a partitioned log, which is data/stream's.

symbols.name: CodeRedisCacheCommandFailed
symbols.doc:
CodeRedisCacheCommandFailed identifies a command Valkey or Redis refused,
or a connection that failed under it. It rides with
core/data/cache.CacheBackendFailed in the error's trail.

symbols.name: CodeRedisCacheValueUndecodable
symbols.doc:
CodeRedisCacheValueUndecodable identifies a stored value the configured
codec cannot decode into the store's type: another writer, another
type, another codec under the same prefix.

symbols.name: CommandFailed

code.public: The cache server could not complete the request

symbols.doc: CommandFailed wraps a failed command; nothing is assumed stored.

symbols.spelled: struct{Client goredis.UniversalClient; Codec codec.Codec; Clock clock.Timed; Prefix string; DefaultTTL time.Duration; FillLease time.Duration; FillPoll time.Duration}
symbols.canonical: struct{Client github.com/redis/go-redis/v9.UniversalClient; Codec github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/core/data/codec.Codec; Clock github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/kernel/clock.Timed; Prefix string; DefaultTTL time.Duration; FillLease time.Duration; FillPoll time.Duration}

fields.name: Client
fields.doc:
Client is the caller's go-redis client — a single node, a sentinel
failover or a cluster. The store never closes it. Required.

fields.name: Codec
fields.doc: Codec encodes and decodes the values. Required.

fields.name: Clock
fields.doc:
Clock times the pollers' waits. Nil means clock.System. An entry's
deadline is the server's, never this clock's.

fields.name: Prefix
fields.doc:
Prefix namespaces every key and is their hash tag, so it must be
non-empty and hold no brace. Required.

fields.name: DefaultTTL
fields.doc:
DefaultTTL applies to an entry whose own TTL is zero; zero means no
deadline, as for the memory store. Negative is refused.

fields.name: FillLease
FillPoll
fields.doc:
FillPoll is how often a caller that lost the fill lease looks for the
winner's value. Required, positive and shorter than FillLease, when
FillLease is positive.

symbols.doc:
Config configures NewStore: the client, the namespace, the default
lifetime, the codec values travel in, and the cross-replica fill lease.

symbols.name: NewStore
symbols.spelled: func[V any](cfg Config) (store corecache.Store[V], err error)
symbols.doc:
NewStore returns the store over cfg.Client under cfg.Prefix. It sends no
command. A missing client or codec, an empty prefix or one holding a
brace, a negative DefaultTTL, and a FillPoll that is not positive and
shorter than a positive FillLease are core/data/cache.CacheMisconfigured.

symbols.name: ValueUndecodable

code.public: A cached value could not be decoded

symbols.doc: ValueUndecodable reports a stored value the codec cannot decode.

symbols.name: CodeRedisQueueCommandRefused
symbols.doc: CodeRedisQueueCommandRefused identifies a command the server answered with an error.

symbols.name: CodeRedisQueueGroupMissing
symbols.doc:
CodeRedisQueueGroupMissing identifies a consumer group the stream does not
have (NOGROUP) while StreamConfig.CreateGroup is false.

symbols.name: CodeRedisQueueMisconfigured
symbols.doc:
CodeRedisQueueMisconfigured identifies a StreamConfig NewStream refuses
before any command: a missing client, an empty or brace-holding stream,
group or consumer name.

symbols.name: CodeRedisQueueUnreachable
symbols.doc:
CodeRedisQueueUnreachable identifies a connection to the server
that failed or timed out; nothing is assumed done.

symbols.name: CommandRefused

code.public: The queue server refused the request

symbols.doc: CommandRefused wraps a command the server answered with an error.

symbols.name: GroupMissing

code.public: The queue's consumer group does not exist

symbols.doc: GroupMissing reports a consumer group the stream does not have.

symbols.name: NewStream
symbols.doc:
NewStream returns a broker over cfg.Stream and cfg.Group. It sends no
command: the group is checked, or created when cfg.CreateGroup asks, on
the first Receive. A policy the broker cannot honour is
core/data/queue.QueueMisconfigured; a missing client or name is
StreamMisconfigured.

fields.name: Client
fields.doc:
Client is the caller's go-redis client; the broker never closes it.
Required.

fields.name: Clock
fields.doc:
Clock stamps every instant the broker writes and judges the lease
deadlines. Nil means clock.System.

fields.name: Stream
fields.doc:
Stream names the queue; it is the hash tag of every key the broker
writes, so it must be non-empty and hold no brace. Required.

fields.name: Group
fields.doc: Group is the consumer group every consumer of the queue reads through. Required.

fields.name: Consumer
fields.doc:
Consumer names this broker in the group's pending-entries list. Empty
mints one per broker; two live brokers must not share one.

fields.name: Policy
fields.doc:
Policy is the delivery discipline. Its zero value is refused, as for
every broker.

fields.name: CreateGroup
fields.doc:
CreateGroup creates the group, and the stream with it (XGROUP CREATE
MKSTREAM), when the first Receive finds it missing. False answers
GroupMissing instead.

symbols.doc:
StreamConfig configures NewStream: the client, the stream and group, this
process's consumer name, and the delivery discipline.

symbols.name: StreamMisconfigured

code.public: The stream queue broker is misconfigured

symbols.doc: StreamMisconfigured refuses a StreamConfig NewStream cannot build a broker from.

symbols.name: StreamUnreachable

code.public: The queue server could not be reached

symbols.doc: StreamUnreachable wraps a connection failure; nothing is assumed done.
